prompt: Asset: compact watercolor enemy entrance emblem for a top-down fantasy forest tower-defense game. Transparent PNG, one isolated icon centered in square canvas. A short rough wooden stake planted in a tiny patch of grass with a small weathered dark-rust/red pennant. Pennant carries a simple ivory silhouette of three boot tracks, suggesting a marching enemy column. Beside the stake, two short ochre wooden trail-arrow chevrons point clearly to the RIGHT, indicating incoming attack direction. No text, no letters, no numbers, no border, no circular badge, no background landscape, no tower, no scary character, no magical portal, no glow. Match hand-painted watercolor and rice-paper pigment grain; warm moss-green, natural wood, muted rust-red and pale ivory. Bold readable shape at 48-64px, few details, restrained natural game-world signpost rather than a modern UI logo. All elements fully inside transparent margins. Slight overhead/isometric view matching a painted forest road. Right-pointing direction essential.
